task.title: Add logging, a health check and alerts
task.description:
## Why
With no server to log in to, problems are only visible if the Worker reports them.

## Steps
1. Turn on Workers logs and log one structured line per job: league format, duration, Sleeper calls, 429 count and outcome.
2. Extend `/api/health` to check storage, the queue and the age of the player database and current values.
3. Add alerts for a high job failure rate, a growing queue, repeated 429s from Sleeper and a daily job that did not run.
4. Record how to read logs and what each alert means in `web/README.md`.

## Done when
- A forced job failure appears in the logs and raises an alert.
- `/api/health` reports stale daily data.
